snippet.title: OUTLIER - Official Game Trailer | Backrooms Hide and Seek
snippet.description:
OUTLIER Official Trailer

Crews sent into the Backrooms have begun reporting strange symptoms. You're one of them. Blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits and relieve the urge behind the Overseer's back.

OUTLIER is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players.

Wishlist OUTLIER on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5207980/OUTLIER/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=story_trailer
